name: Ang Thong Marine Park Day Tour by Speedboat from Koh Samui
park_fee: Ang Thong park fee 300 THB per adult / 150 THB per child (3–14), cash at the park
notice: Ang Thong Marine Park closes 1 November–15 December. Season reopens 16 December.
short: A full day by speedboat in Ang Thong National Marine Park: the Emerald Lake on Koh Mae Ko, the Koh Wua Talab viewpoint, kayaking, snorkelling and lunch. Hotel pickup from most areas of Koh Samui.
included: Hotel pickup and drop-off from most areas of Koh Samui
Lunch, fruit, water and soft drinks
Children's life jackets (must be worn on the boat)
not_included: Ang Thong National Park fee: 300 THB adult / 150 THB child, cash at the park
itinerary: 10:00 | Koh Mae Ko: walk up to the Emerald Lake (Thale Nai) viewpoint
14:00 | Koh Wua Talab: viewpoint climb and beach time
faq: Does the Ang Thong speedboat tour run in November? | No. Ang Thong Marine Park closes every year from 1 November to 15 December and the first departure of the season is 16 December. In that window we run Pig Island and Koh Tao trips from Koh Samui instead, and you can already book Ang Thong dates from 16 December.

Is the park fee included in the Ang Thong speedboat tour price? | No. The national park fee is paid in cash at the park: 300 THB per adult and 150 THB per child aged 3–14. Thai nationals pay 40 and 20 THB. Bring exact cash; there is no card payment in the park.

How long is the speedboat ride from Koh Samui to Ang Thong? | About 60 to 75 minutes each way depending on sea conditions, with the pier briefing around 09:00 and the first stop in the park by mid-morning. The whole day runs about eight hours door to door.

Can I swim in the Emerald Lake? | No. Swimming in the Emerald Lake (Thale Nai) on Koh Mae Ko is not allowed; it is a protected saltwater lagoon viewed from the wooden walkway and viewpoint above it. Swimming and snorkelling happen at the beach and reef stops.

How hard is the climb to the Ang Thong viewpoint? | The Koh Wua Talab viewpoint is a steep climb of roughly 20–30 minutes on rock steps and ladders with ropes. Wear grippy shoes and bring water. Guests who prefer not to climb can stay on the beach; the Emerald Lake walkway is shorter and easier.

Can children and non-swimmers join the Ang Thong speedboat tour? | Yes. Children aged 3–11 pay the child price and infants up to 2 travel free; children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on the boat. Non-swimmers can snorkel in a life jacket close to the guide or stay on the beach.

Will I get seasick on the speedboat to Ang Thong? | The crossing is fast and can be bumpy in swell, especially October to December. Take a seasickness tablet an hour before departure if you are prone to it, sit near the back of the boat and eat a light breakfast. From February to April the sea is usually calm.

Can the boat drop me on Koh Phangan after the Ang Thong tour? | No. Tour boats return to the island they departed from, so the Koh Samui trip ends back on Koh Samui. If you are moving on to Koh Phangan, take the tour on the day before you travel, or join the Koh Phangan departure instead.

What should I bring on the Ang Thong day tour? | Swimwear, a towel, reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses, water shoes or sandals with grip for the viewpoint, a dry bag for your phone, cash for the park fee and any seasickness tablets. Lunch, water and soft drinks are included.

Which areas of Koh Samui does the Ang Thong speedboat pickup cover? | Pickup is included from most areas of Koh Samui, including Chaweng, Lamai, Bophut, Maenam, Choeng Mon and Bang Rak. Lipa Noi, Nathon, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao and Thong Krut carry an extra 400 THB per person return. You can also meet the boat at the pier.

name: Ang Thong Marine Park Day Tour by Big Boat from Koh Samui
park_fee: Ang Thong park fee 300 THB per adult / 150 THB per child (3–14), cash at the park
notice: Ang Thong Marine Park closes 1 November–15 December. Season reopens 16 December.
short: The relaxed way to see Ang Thong: a slower big boat with deck space, the Emerald Lake, the Koh Wua Talab viewpoint, kayaking and snorkelling. The best value Ang Thong day from Koh Samui.
included: Hotel pickup and drop-off from most areas of Koh Samui
Lunch, fruit, water and soft drinks
not_included: Ang Thong National Park fee: 300 THB adult / 150 THB child, cash
itinerary: Emerald Lake | Koh Mae Ko walkway and viewpoint
Koh Wua Talab | Viewpoint and beach
faq: What is the difference between the Ang Thong big boat and the speedboat tour? | The big boat takes about 10 hours and costs 1,500 THB; it is slower, steadier and has shaded deck space, which suits families, older guests and anyone prone to seasickness. The speedboat takes about 8 hours for 1,800 THB and spends more of the day in the park. Both visit the Emerald Lake and Koh Wua Talab.

Is the Ang Thong big boat tour suitable for seasickness? | It is the better choice. A larger hull moves less in swell than a speedboat, and you can sit in the shade or on deck in fresh air. It is still an open-sea crossing, so take a tablet before departure if you are sensitive.

Is lunch included on the Ang Thong big boat tour? | Yes. Lunch, fruit, water and soft drinks are included and served on board [confirm menu with Mea]. Tell us about vegetarian or allergy needs when you book.

Does the big boat tour include the Emerald Lake and the viewpoint? | Yes. The route includes Koh Mae Ko with the Emerald Lake walkway and Koh Wua Talab with the viewpoint climb and beach, plus kayaking and snorkelling stops. The exact order depends on sea conditions on the day.

Is the Ang Thong park fee included in the big boat price? | No. The park fee of 300 THB per adult and 150 THB per child is paid in cash at the park entrance and is not included in any Ang Thong tour price.

Can I book the Ang Thong big boat for a date in November? | Not for November 1–15 December, when the park is closed. Dates from 16 December onwards are open for booking now, and we suggest Pig Island or Koh Tao for the closure weeks.

How many hours is the Ang Thong big boat trip from Koh Samui? | About 10 hours door to door, including hotel pickup and drop-off. The crossing itself is slower than by speedboat, which is why the day is longer.

Is the big boat tour good for children? | Yes. There is more space to move around, shade and a toilet on board, and children's life jackets are provided and must be worn. Children aged 3–11 pay the child price and infants up to 2 travel free.

short: Ang Thong with only 15 guests on a big speedboat: more space, more time in the water and a more personal day with the guide. Emerald Lake, Koh Wua Talab, kayaking and snorkelling from Koh Samui.
included: Hotel pickup and drop-off from most areas of Koh Samui
Big VIP speedboat with only 15 guests
Lunch, fruit, water and soft drinks [confirm VIP extras with Mea]
not_included: Ang Thong National Park fee: 300 THB adult / 150 THB child, cash
itinerary: Kayak and snorkel | Longer stops with a small group
Koh Wua Talab | Viewpoint and beach
faq: How many guests are on the Ang Thong VIP tour? | Only 15 guests on a big speedboat. That is the whole point of the VIP tour: space to move, no queue for the kayaks or snorkel gear, and a guide who has time for everyone.

Why is the VIP Ang Thong tour 4,500 THB? | You pay for comfort and attention: a big speedboat with just 15 guests, longer stops and a more personal day. The standard speedboat tour at 1,800 THB visits the same highlights in a bigger group.
Is the park fee included in the VIP tour price? | No. As on every Ang Thong tour, the park fee of 300 THB per adult and 150 THB per child is paid in cash at the park.

Is the VIP tour better for seasickness than the standard speedboat? | A bigger speedboat with fewer people on board rides more comfortably, but it is still a speedboat crossing. If you are very sensitive, the big boat tour is the steadiest option.

Can we book the whole VIP boat for our group? | Yes. For a group of 15 or fewer, the private speedboat option gives you the boat and the day to yourselves; message us on WhatsApp for the price and timings.

What is included in the Ang Thong VIP tour? | Hotel pickup from most areas, the VIP speedboat with 15 guests, a guide, lunch, drinks, snorkel gear and kayaks. The park fee and remote-area transfers are extra [confirm VIP extras with Mea].
Does the VIP tour run during the Ang Thong closure? | No. Ang Thong Marine Park is closed 1 November–15 December every year; the VIP tour resumes on 16 December and dates can be booked in advance.

Is the VIP Ang Thong tour suitable for children? | Yes, and the small group makes it easier with children. Children aged 3–11 pay the child price, infants travel free, and children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on the boat.

short: Stay the night in Ang Thong Marine Park: the day-trip highlights, then the park to yourselves after the boats leave, a sunset from Koh Wua Talab, a tent on the beach and a second morning in the islands.

Tent and bedding at the park headquarters on Koh Wua Talab

faq: What is the cancellation policy for the Ang Thong overnight camping trip? | Full refund if you cancel 48 hours or more before departure; no refund under 48 hours or for a no-show. If we cancel because of weather or sea conditions, you choose a full refund or a new date.

Where do we sleep on the Ang Thong overnight trip? | In tents at the national park headquarters on Koh Wua Talab, the only island in the park with facilities. Bathrooms and toilets there are very clean. Bungalows are available on the bungalow version of this trip.

What is the difference between the tent and bungalow overnight trips? | Both follow the same two-day programme. The tent trip costs 3,600 THB per person; the bungalow trip costs 4,200 THB and includes a park bungalow instead of a tent. We take care of the booking, so you don't need to deal with the park's own system.
Is the park fee included in the overnight price? | No. The park fee of 300 THB per adult and 150 THB per child is paid in cash on arrival, the same as on day tours.

Is there electricity and phone signal in Ang Thong overnight? | There is limited electricity at the park headquarters in the evening and patchy mobile signal. Bring a power bank, a torch and anything you can't do without for a night.

Can children join the Ang Thong overnight camping trip? | Yes. Children aged 3–11 pay the child price and infants travel free. Children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on the boat. It suits families who are comfortable with basic camping.

What should I pack for one night in Ang Thong? | Swimwear, a towel, a change of clothes, insect repellent, a torch, a power bank, sunscreen, grippy shoes for the viewpoint, cash for the park fee and personal medication. Bedding is provided.
Does the overnight trip run in November? | No. The park is closed 1 November–15 December; overnight trips resume on 16 December and you can book dates from then now.

faq: What are the Ang Thong park bungalows like? | Simple national-park bungalows on Koh Wua Talab with a bed, fan and private bathroom; the bathrooms and toilets are very clean. They are the only indoor accommodation in the marine park and we book them as part of the trip.
Do I need to book the park bungalow myself? | No. The bungalow is included in the price and we arrange it; you don't need to use the park's own booking system or know the bungalow rates.
Is the bungalow overnight trip available all year? | It runs from 16 December to 31 October. The park closes 1 November–15 December every year.

What is the cancellation policy for the Ang Thong bungalow trip? | Full refund 48 hours or more before departure; no refund under 48 hours or for a no-show. Weather or sea-safety cancellations by us: full refund or a new date, your choice.
Can two people share one bungalow? | Yes, bungalows sleep two or more depending on the unit [confirm with Mea]; tell us your group when you book and we allocate accordingly.
Is the park fee included in the bungalow trip? | No. The 300 THB adult / 150 THB child park fee is paid in cash on arrival.

Is the bungalow trip suitable for families? | Yes. It is the more comfortable overnight option for families with children; children aged 3–11 pay the child price and life jackets are provided and must be worn on the boat.

What meals are included on the overnight trip? | Lunch on day one, dinner, breakfast and lunch on day two, with water and soft drinks [confirm menu with Mea]. Tell us about dietary needs when booking.

faq: How much is a private speedboat to Ang Thong from Koh Samui? | 33,000 THB per boat for about 8 hours, including captain, crew, fuel, snorkel gear, kayaks and soft drinks. The park fee, lunch and land transfers are extra.

Is lunch included on the Ang Thong private speedboat? | Lunch is optional. The boat can stop at a restaurant where you order and pay for what you like, or you can bring your own food and drinks on board.

Do you pick us up from the hotel for the private boat? | Land transfers are optional. Many guests come to the pier themselves; we send the pier location when you book. Ask us for a transfer price if you would like one.

How many people fit on the private Ang Thong speedboat? | It depends on the boat we assign [ask Mea]; tell us your group size and we confirm the right boat. For larger groups we have bigger speedboats and catamarans in our charter fleet.

Can we choose our own itinerary in Ang Thong? | Yes, within park rules and safe sea conditions. You can spend longer snorkelling, skip the viewpoint climb or stay for the quiet afternoon when the day boats leave.
Is the park fee included in the private boat price? | No. The 300 THB adult / 150 THB child park fee is paid in cash on arrival, as on every Ang Thong trip.
Can the private boat take us from Ang Thong to Koh Phangan? | No. Boats return to the island they departed from, so the Koh Samui charter returns to Koh Samui.

What happens if the sea is too rough for the private speedboat? | If we cancel for weather or sea safety, you choose a full refund or a new date. Your own cancellations get a full refund 48 hours or more before departure and no refund under 48 hours.

pier: Thong Krut pier, south Koh Samui
park_fee: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB per person, cash on arrival (where not included)
short: Half a day with the pigs of Koh Madsum and the reef at Koh Tan, by shared speedboat from Thong Krut in the south of Koh Samui. Snorkel gear, life jackets and a meal included; runs every day of the year.
included: Minibus pickup from most areas of Koh Samui to Thong Krut pier
not_included: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB per person, cash on arrival (where not included)
itinerary: Pickup | Minibus from your hotel to Thong Krut pier (time sent the evening before)
Pig Island | Beach time with the pigs, swimming
Koh Tan | Snorkelling on the reef
Return | Back at Thong Krut and minibus to your hotel
faq: Where is Pig Island and how far is it from Koh Samui? | Pig Island is the nickname of Koh Madsum, a small island off the south-west coast of Koh Samui. Boats leave from Thong Krut pier and the crossing takes 15 to 30 minutes.

Can you swim with the pigs on Koh Madsum? | The pigs live on the beach and wander into the shallows, so you will swim near them. Don't chase or pick them up and don't feed them junk food; the guides have the right food if feeding is allowed on the day.

Does the Pig Island tour run in November and December? | Yes. Pig Island and Koh Tan are not part of the national park, so this trip runs every day of the year, weather permitting, including the weeks when Ang Thong is closed.
Is there a landing fee on Pig Island? | There is a small island fee of about 50 THB per person, paid in cash on arrival, unless your tour page says it is included.

Is the snorkelling good at Koh Tan? | Koh Tan is the better snorkelling stop of the two, with a shallow reef close to the beach. Visibility is best from February to September; after heavy rain it drops.

Is the Pig Island tour suitable for young children? | Yes. It is short, the beach is shallow and children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on the boat. Children aged 3–11 pay the child price; infants up to 2 travel free.

Which Koh Samui areas does the Pig Island pickup cover? | Pickup is by minibus from most areas of Koh Samui to Thong Krut pier. Because the pier is in the south-west, the surcharge zones differ from our Chaweng-side departures; see the pickup areas on the booking card.
How do I book the Pig Island speedboat for tomorrow? | Book online until midnight Thailand time the day before; we send your pickup time the same evening. For same-day trips, message us on WhatsApp.

name: Pig Island Small-Group Longtail Boat Tour from Koh Samui
short: The slow, local way to Pig Island: a traditional longtail with no more than 12 guests, lunch on Koh Tan, snorkelling and more time on each island than the speedboat trip.
included: Pickup from most areas of Koh Samui
faq: How many people are on the Pig Island longtail tour? | A maximum of 12 guests, which keeps the beaches and the boat relaxed. It is the small-group option for Pig Island.
Is lunch included on the Pig Island longtail tour? | Yes, lunch is served on Koh Tan and the Koh Madsum island fee is included in the 1,750 THB price.

Longtail or speedboat to Pig Island: which is better? | The speedboat is faster and cheaper (1,450 THB, 4–5 hours); the longtail is slower, quieter, limited to 12 guests and gives you about 6 hours with lunch included. Choose the longtail for a calmer day, the speedboat for a quick half day.

Is the longtail boat safe in waves? | Longtails run in the sheltered water between Thong Krut and the islands and the captains know the conditions. Life jackets are provided and children must wear them. If the sea is unsafe, we move the trip or refund you.
Does the Pig Island longtail tour run every day? | Yes, all year round, weather permitting. There is no seasonal closure.
Is the longtail tour good for families? | Yes. The small group and lunch stop make it easy with children; children aged 3–11 pay the child price and infants travel free.
Where does the longtail leave from? | Thong Krut pier in the south-west of Koh Samui. Minibus pickup from most areas is included; see the pickup areas for any surcharge.
Can I snorkel from the longtail? | Yes. Snorkel gear is provided and the main stop is the reef at Koh Tan, with a beach stop at Koh Madsum.

name: Pig Island Sunset Tour from Koh Samui
pickup_window: Early afternoon, sent the evening before
park_fee: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB, cash (where not included)
short: Pig Island in the softer afternoon light, snorkelling at Koh Tan, then dinner and the sunset over the Five Islands from the water. The afternoon version of our most popular trip.
included: Pickup from most areas of Koh Samui
not_included: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB (where not included)

Koh Madsum | Pigs and beach in the afternoon light
Sunset | On the water, then return
faq: What time does the Pig Island sunset tour leave? | Pickup is in the early afternoon and the exact time is sent the evening before. You are back at your hotel after sunset.
Is dinner included on the Pig Island sunset tour? | Yes, dinner is included; tell us about dietary needs when you book.

Is the sunset tour better than the morning Pig Island trip? | The light is softer, the beaches are quieter after the morning boats leave and you get the sunset over the Five Islands. The morning trip is shorter and slightly cheaper.
Does the Pig Island sunset tour run in the rainy season? | Yes, every day of the year weather permitting. October to December brings showers; if the sea is unsafe we move or refund the trip.
Can children join the sunset tour? | Yes. Children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on the boat. Children aged 3–11 pay the child price and infants up to 2 travel free.
Where is the sunset seen from? | From the boat and the west-facing beaches between Koh Madsum and Thong Krut, looking towards the Five Islands and the mainland.
Which pickup areas are covered for the sunset tour? | Minibus pickup from most areas of Koh Samui to Thong Krut pier; see the pickup areas on the booking card for any surcharge.
Is the Koh Madsum island fee included in the sunset tour? | A fee of about 50 THB per person is paid in cash on arrival unless the tour states it is included.

name: Pink Dolphins and Pig Island Tour from Koh Samui
season: All year [check: best season for dolphins]
park_fee: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB, cash (where not included)
short: Look for the Indo-Pacific humpback dolphins, the famous pink dolphins of the south-west coast, then visit Pig Island and snorkel at Koh Tan. Sightings are wild and not guaranteed; the pigs are.
included: Pickup from most areas of Koh Samui
Shared speedboat with a dolphin-spotting captain
not_included: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB (where not included)
itinerary: Morning | Pickup and minibus to Thong Krut
Dolphin search | Along the south-west coast
faq: Are pink dolphin sightings guaranteed on this tour? | No. These are wild Indo-Pacific humpback dolphins and we never chase or feed them. Captains know where they feed and sightings are common [check: give an honest rate from Mea's logs], but the Pig Island and Koh Tan stops are the guaranteed part of the day.
When is the best time of year to see pink dolphins off Koh Samui? | [check with Mea's captains] The calm months from February to September make spotting easier because the surface is flat.
Why are the dolphins pink? | Indo-Pacific humpback dolphins are born dark grey and lose pigment as they age, turning pale pink. Adults around Koh Samui are often mottled pink and grey.
Is this tour ethical? | We keep distance, cut the engine when dolphins are near and never feed or follow them. The pigs on Koh Madsum are not chased or fed junk food.
How long is the Pink Dolphins and Pig Island tour? | About 6 hours including the pickup, the dolphin search, Pig Island, snorkelling and lunch at Koh Tan.
Is lunch included on the pink dolphin tour? | Yes. Lunch is included; the Koh Madsum island fee of about 50 THB is paid in cash on arrival unless stated as included.
Can children join the dolphin tour? | Yes. Children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on the boat; children aged 3–11 pay the child price and infants travel free.
What if we see no dolphins? | The rest of the day runs as planned. We do not refund for no sightings, because they are wild animals, and we say so before you book.

faq: How much is a private longtail to Pig Island? | 5,950 THB per boat for 5–6 hours, for up to 8 guests, including the captain and snorkel gear. Food, the island fee and hotel transfers are extra.
Is the private longtail price per person or per boat? | Per boat. Eight guests pay the same as two.
Can we leave at a time of our choice? | Yes, within daylight hours and safe sea conditions. Early departures get the quietest beaches.
Is food included on the private longtail? | No. Bring your own picnic and drinks, or ask the captain to stop at a restaurant on Koh Tan where you order and pay.
Can you pick us up from our hotel for the private boat? | Transfers are available on request; most guests come to Thong Krut pier themselves and we send the location.
How many guests fit on the private longtail? | Up to 8. For bigger groups, the private speedboat takes up to 10 and our catamarans take more.
Is the private longtail good for children? | Yes. It is a calm, shallow-water trip with life jackets for children, who must wear them on the boat.
Can we do three islands on the private longtail? | Yes: the Koh Madsum, Koh Tan and Koh Rap trip at 8,450 THB per boat adds the third island.

name: Private Speedboat to Pig Island and Koh Tan (up to 10)
park_fee: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB per person, cash
short: A private speedboat for up to 10 guests to Pig Island and Koh Tan: faster crossings, more time on the beaches and reef, and your own schedule from Thong Krut.
included: Private speedboat, captain and crew for 5–6 hours
not_included: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB per person, cash
itinerary: Flexible | Meet at Thong Krut pier

faq: How much is a private speedboat to Pig Island from Koh Samui? | 11,950 THB per boat for 5–6 hours for up to 10 guests, including captain, crew, fuel and snorkel gear.

Speedboat or longtail for a private Pig Island trip? | The speedboat (11,950 THB, up to 10) is faster and can add stops; the longtail (5,950 THB, up to 8) is slower and cheaper. For a short crossing like this, the longtail is good value; the speedboat suits larger groups and extra islands.

Can the private speedboat add Koh Rap or other islands? | Yes. Ask when booking; the Koh Madsum, Koh Tan and Koh Rap trip and the Koh Rap full day are set itineraries, and custom routes are possible by WhatsApp.
Is food included on the private speedboat? | No. Bring your own or stop at a restaurant on Koh Tan.
Where does the private speedboat leave from? | Thong Krut pier on the south-west coast. Transfers are available on request.
How far ahead should I book a private speedboat? | Two or three days is usually enough outside peak season; from mid-December to mid-January and around Songkran, book a week or more ahead.
What happens if the weather is bad on the day? | If we cancel for sea safety you choose a full refund or a new date. Light rain does not stop the trip.
Can we bring our own drinks on board? | Yes, including a cool box; glass is best avoided on the boat.

name: Three Islands Private Boat: Koh Madsum, Koh Tan and Koh Rap (up to 8)
park_fee: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB per person, cash
short: Three islands off the south-west coast in one private longtail day: the pigs on Koh Madsum, the reef at Koh Tan and the quieter beach at Koh Rap, for up to 8 guests.
included: Private longtail boat and captain for 5–6 hours
not_included: Koh Madsum island fee about 50 THB per person, cash
itinerary: Koh Rap | Quiet beach and swimming
faq: What is Koh Rap? | Koh Rap (Koh Raab) is a small island south-west of Koh Tan with a quiet beach and clear water, reached only by private boat. It is the third stop on this trip.
Is the three-island trip per boat? | Yes: 8,450 THB per boat for up to 8 guests.
How long does the three-island private boat take? | 5–6 hours, with time on each island. Start early for the calmest water.
Is food included? | No. Bring a picnic or stop for lunch on Koh Tan.
Is there snorkelling at Koh Rap? | Yes, there is a reef off the beach [check visibility notes with Mea]; Koh Tan remains the main snorkel stop.
Can we swap Koh Rap for another island? | Ask on WhatsApp; the captain can suggest options depending on the sea on the day.
Is the three-island trip suitable for children? | Yes, with life jackets provided and worn on the boat. Keep the day short with very young children.
What is the cancellation policy? | Full refund 48 hours or more before departure, 50% between 24 and 48 hours, none under 24 hours. Weather cancellations by us: full refund or a new date.

name: Koh Rap Full-Day Private Boat from Koh Samui
short: A full private day on and around Koh Rap, the quiet island beyond Koh Tan: swimming, snorkelling and a beach to yourselves, with the option of stopping at Pig Island on the way.

faq: How long is the speedboat from Koh Samui to Koh Tao? | About 1.5 to 2 hours each way. The day runs roughly nine hours door to door, with two or three snorkel stops, the Koh Nang Yuan viewpoint and lunch.

Is the Koh Nang Yuan island fee included in the day trip? | No. Koh Nang Yuan charges 250 THB per adult, paid in cash on arrival. Plastic bottles, fins and water shoes are not allowed on the island, and drones are banned.

Does the Koh Tao day trip run in November and December? | Yes. Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan are not affected by the Ang Thong closure, so this trip runs all year, weather permitting, and is our main alternative while Ang Thong is closed.

Is snorkelling at Koh Tao good for beginners? | Yes. The bays are shallow with reef close to the surface and the guide stays with the group. Life jackets are provided and children must wear them on the boat.
What is the price of the Koh Tao day trip from Koh Samui? | 2,200 THB per adult in 2026, the same price as from Koh Phangan. The child price is shown on the booking card.
Is lunch included on the Koh Tao and Nang Yuan trip? | Yes: lunch, fruit, water and soft drinks are included.
Can I stay on Koh Tao instead of returning? | No. The tour boat returns to Koh Samui; for a one-way trip, take a ferry instead and we can suggest timings.
Which Koh Samui areas does the Koh Tao pickup cover? | Pickup is included from most areas; Lipa Noi, Nathon, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao and Thong Krut carry an extra 400 THB per person return.

faq: How do I get from Koh Samui to the Full Moon Party? | The easiest way is our shared return speedboat: pickup at your hotel, a 30–45 minute crossing to Haad Rin, and a return boat through the night, for 1,400 THB per person. Ferries also run, but the last public boats leave early and the Haad Rin Queen is a 50-minute wooden ferry from Big Buddha pier.

What time do the Full Moon Party boats leave and return? | Departures run between 18:00 and 23:00 from Koh Samui with hotel pickup before your slot. Return boats run through the night and early morning [confirm the return schedule with Mea].
Is the Full Moon Party entry ticket included? | No. We do not sell party tickets. Entry is about 200 THB, paid at the gate in Haad Rin.

When is the next Full Moon Party? | The next dates are 24 November, 24 December and 31 December 2026 (New Year's Eve), then 22 January, 22 February and 22 March 2027. The full list is on our Full Moon Party dates page; a few 2027 dates move off Buddhist holidays.

Is it safe to take a speedboat at night to the Full Moon Party? | Our boats run only in safe sea conditions with life jackets for everyone and experienced captains who make this crossing every month. If the sea is too rough we cancel and refund in full.
What happens if the sea is too rough on party night? | We cancel the boat and you get a full refund or move to the next party. Boats run subject to safe sea conditions.
Can I book the Full Moon boat on the day of the party? | Online bookings close at midnight the day before. On the day, message us on WhatsApp and we will tell you if seats are left.
Which hotels does the Full Moon boat pick up from? | Most areas of Koh Samui are included; Lipa Noi, Nathon, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao and Thong Krut carry an extra 400 THB per person return.

Can I book the Full Moon boat for a group of 10 or more? | Yes, and for groups a private speedboat is often better value and lets you set your own times. Message us on WhatsApp with your date and group size.

Is the Full Moon Party on the same night as Loy Krathong this year? | Yes. On Tuesday 24 November 2026 the Full Moon Party and Loy Krathong fall on the same night, so Haad Rin and the Samui beaches are both busy; book the boat early.

How much is the Half Moon package? | From 2,700 THB per person [ask Mea: confirm the three options]. The festival's own Magic Forest ticket is 2,500 THB online, so the package adds the boat for a small difference.
Where is the Half Moon Festival? | In the Ban Tai jungle on Koh Phangan, about 20 minutes from Thong Sala pier, on a purpose-built forest site with several stages.
What time does the Half Moon Festival start and finish? | The Magic Forest runs from about 21:00 until sunrise. Boat times from Koh Samui are set around that [confirm with Mea].
